full_prompt_en: A square flat cartoon illustration shows one pale blond person from the waist upward against a completely solid vermilion-orange background. The orange reaches all four edges and carries no setting, pattern, horizon, shadow, or visible text. The figure stands slightly left of center, leaving a wide open orange field to the right and above. The upper body turns toward the right, while the head faces nearly forward. Short blond hair is represented by a pale filled area with a row of quick black strokes along the crown and a few on the side. A single rounded ear projects from the left contour of the elongated face. Two empty white oval eyes, thin short brows, a bent nose mark, and a tiny mouth make a mildly curious, neutral expression. The long narrow neck descends into a loose black top. Its shoulders are rounded, and its lower edge ends in uneven, scratchy strokes rather than a clean hem. One pale arm crosses the lower right of the torso; a simplified hand wraps around a short black cup held near the chest. Two thin white horizontal lines define the cup rim. Most of the clothing is a dense black silhouette with a few dry brush flecks, while the face and hand are flat pale peach. The black outlines vary slightly in width and wobble like spontaneous marker drawing. There is no modeled depth, and the tiny white eye and cup accents are the only bright interruptions of the orange, peach, and black blocks. Light is represented as even flat graphic color, without a directional source or cast shadow. The overall composition is sparse, warm, and gently comic, using a small off-center figure and a large uninterrupted orange field for immediate visual clarity.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平面漫画插画呈现一位浅肤色金发人物的腰上形象，背景是完全纯净的朱红橙色。橙色延伸到四边，没有场景、图案、地平线、阴影或可见文字。人物略偏左站立，右侧和上方留下宽阔橙色空域。上身朝右转，头几乎向前。短金发由浅色填面构成，头顶排着一列迅速的黑短线，侧面也有几笔。细长脸的左轮廓凸出一只圆耳朵。两个空白白色椭圆眼睛、短细眉、一笔弯鼻和极小的嘴组成略带好奇而中性的表情。细长脖子接一件宽松黑上衣。肩膀圆润，下边缘以不齐整的刮擦线收尾，而非干净衣摆。一只浅色手臂横过躯干右下，简化的手握住胸口附近一只短黑杯。两道细白横线界定杯沿。衣服大部分是浓黑剪影，带少数干笔白点，脸与手则是平坦浅桃色。黑轮廓粗细略有变化，像随手用记号笔画出的轻微颤线。画面没有塑造纵深，眼睛与杯子上极少的白色是橙、桃、黑色块中唯一明亮打断。光以均匀平涂色表现，没有定向光源或投影。整体构图稀疏、温暖又轻微幽默，用偏心的小人物与大片连续橙色立即建立视觉清晰感。
style_prompt_en: The flat cartoon style relies on an uninterrupted saturated color field, thick irregular black contour, and a small number of simple filled shapes. Pale peach, dense black, and tiny white marks stand out sharply against the dominant warm hue. Faces or forms are reduced to a handful of economical strokes, with asymmetry and slight line wobble preserving a spontaneous hand-drawn quality. Dark areas may retain a few dry-brush flecks instead of mechanically perfect fill. The composition gives generous negative space around a compact off-center focal mass. Light stays even and graphic; no shading or cast shadow is needed to explain the forms. The overall effect is direct, playful, and instantly legible, with restraint making each small mark count.
style_prompt_zh: 这种平面漫画风格依靠连续的饱和色域、粗而不规整的黑轮廓和少数简洁填色形状。浅桃色、浓黑与极小白色记号在主导暖色前鲜明凸出。形体被压缩成少数简练笔画，不对称和轻微线条颤动保留随手画出的质感。深色区域可以留少数干笔白点，而非机械完美的填色。构图在紧凑偏心焦点周围留下充裕负空间。光保持均匀和图形化，不靠阴影或投影解释形体。整体效果直接、活泼且立即可读，克制使每个小记号都有作用。
theme_en: A simple line-drawn blond person holding a dark cup on orange
theme_zh: 橙色底上手持深色杯子的简笔金发人物
name: Jean Jullien
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
